title: Eval Scenario Criteria
description: Schema for evals/scenario-N/criteria.json. Scored checklist items carry max_score and must sum to 100. A failure check (failure_check: true) is pass or fail, has no max_score, and is outside the 100 sum, so it never changes a score.

schema_version.description: Optional. Files without it are read as version 1.

context.description: What the scenario tests and why.

failure_check.description: True marks a behaviour the response must not show. Optional; omit for an ordinary scored item.
